rows.medi_said: It's بعيد, right? بعيد.
rows.why: For 'I removed' he offered the present ba2eem (engine wrote بعيد; he confirmed 'بعيم, that's right' after her بقيم); she gave the past إمت and he repeated it.

rows.medi_said: Do you guys use enough كافية? Is, uh، is this an Arabic word or no?
rows.why: He asked whether كافية is the word for 'enough'; she supplied بكفي (didn't-know).

rows.medi_said: كل اليوم مش-- uh، ما عندي بكافية وقت.
rows.why: He blended her بكفي with كافية into a made-up بكافية and put it before the noun; she recast it as وقت بكفي.

rows.medi_said: كل اليوم مش-- uh، ما عندي بكافية وقت.
rows.why: kul + el- = all of the day; the context (every day he lacks time) wants kul yoam = every day; she let it pass.
rows.english: Every day I don't have enough time

rows.medi_said: is a بعيد اللعبة و Instagram.
rows.amal_said: بقيم. حسيت إنه، إنه تغير إشي لما إمت الـ Instagram والـ ألعاب؟
rows.why: Again the present ba2eem (engine wrote بعيد) for a past removal, and singular اللعبة for the games; she re-asked with past إمت and plural الألعاب. Could be her plain re-asking.
rows.english: since I removed the games and Instagram

rows.medi_said: راح يسعد. Yeah، راح يسعدني.
rows.why: يسعد = make happy, not help (sheet 'help | Saa3ed | ساعد'); his 'still doesn't help?' shows he meant help; she voiced يساعد (long-vowel near-sound, F2).
rows.english: I feel it will help me

rows.medi_said: بفكر إنه كل إشي بيحر-- كل إشي بيحر-- بيحرك.
rows.amal_said: بيت حرك. ... لا، بيت is you getting moved. So كل إشي gets moved.
rows.why: بيحرك = moves something; for 'everything is moving' it needs the t- form بيتحرك; she recast and explained, he repeated بيت حرك.

rows.medi_said: بدك، بدك المطر؟
rows.why: He asked if she wants the rain (بدك) right after she said the rain was lovely; she answered with بحب and he took it ('Yeah, بتحب, yeah').

rows.medi_said: Yeah, بـ-بتحب، yeah.
rows.why: Repeating her verb to Amal he used the masculine you-form بتحب instead of بتحبي; she let it pass.

rows.medi_said: الفلسطينيين، uh، ناخد المطر؟
rows.why: Subject is 'the Palestinians' (they) but he used the we-form ناخد with no b-; she only asked what he meant and he switched to English.
rows.english: Do the Palestinians collect the rain(water)?

rows.medi_said: أنا جربت بس الـ set، uh, يخرب، uh, يخرب-- يخرب-- يخرب؟
rows.why: For 'the set broke' he used the present يخرب; she gave the past خرب(ه), and at 13:48 he said خرب and she confirmed.
rows.english: I tried but the set broke

rows.medi_said: بنت به. Uh, بنت به. ... is to, to take care of something.
rows.amal_said: Actually، بنتبه is more like pay attention.
rows.right: بنتبه = pay attention (take care = ديري بالك)
rows.why: He gave بنتبه as 'take care of'; she said it means pay attention, and he switched to ديري بالك for take care.

rows.medi_said: Is it لا?
rows.why: Drill: what preposition بنتبه takes; he guessed لـ and she gave على (a guess phrased as a question).

rows.medi_said: انتبه هي، انتبه هي. Uh, لي.
rows.why: She had just taught بنتبه takes على; he said entebhi li, she said Mhm; her chat (not voiced) wrote 3alayy.

rows.medi_said: ديري بالك على الأكل في المطبخ
rows.right: في المطبخ (el- missing in his first try)
rows.why: She echoed 'في.' and he answered 'الـ مطبخ', so he had said fi matba5 without el- (engine wrote في المطبخ); prompt-then-fix.
rows.english: Take care of the food in the kitchen

rows.medi_said: أنا نسيت.
rows.why: He could not recall 'practice' and said he forgot; she supplied بتدرب (didn't-know).

rows.medi_said: بتدرب لا؟
rows.why: Drill: بتدرب takes على; he guessed لـ and she gave على.

rows.medi_said: Great. تمارنتي
rows.why: Asked for a command he said tmarranti; she prompted 'أمر.' and he gave تمارني.

rows.medi_said: بيجيب اللي. ... بيجيب اللي أي.
rows.amal_said: جبيلي إياه. Why did you put be؟
rows.why: Asked for 'bring it to me' as a command he used the present بيجيب; she gave جيبيلي إياه and asked why he put b-.

rows.medi_said: Trump hadeekna,
rows.chat: Trump de7ek 3alaina lamma 7akalna ma fi 7arb deeda
rows.why: For 'Trump fooled us' he put the object on the verb (de7ekna); she repeated ضحك twice and he gave tehekalayna (de7ek 3alaina).

rows.medi_said: la harb jadeed.

rows.chat: Trump de7ek 3alaina lamma 7akalna ma fi 7arb deeda
rows.why: 'No new war' needs ma fi; she steered him in English ('there won't be') and he said masi (ma fi). He also asked 'la or mish?', so partly a question.

rows.medi_said: Uruk.
rows.why: She said 'We didn't learn the plural for حرب' and gave حروب after his attempt (engine wrote Uruk): a new word, didn't-know.

rows.medi_said: so sa, uh, safri

rows.chat: saafri 3ala hadik el-dawle iza biddek jbaal
rows.why: Command of بسافر keeps the long aa (saafri); he said safri short and said 'I said it wrong'; vowel length.

rows.medi_said: Hadik al-dawla, uh, is, uh, biddik jibal.
rows.amal_said: الجبال. ... جبال. جبال. جبل. جبل is one.
rows.chat: saafri 3ala hadik el-dawle iza biddek jbaal
rows.why: He asked 'What did I say?' and she contrasted جبال with 'جبل is one', so he likely said the singular (engine wrote jibal) for 'mountains'; may be only the jbaal vowel.

rows.medi_said: I don't know how to say surprise.
rows.why: He said he doesn't know how to say surprise; she supplied مفاجأة.
